Courtyard-facing, quiet side

Garden Room

Set around the cypress courtyard on the sheltered side of the property. No ocean from the window — but the courtyard is where most of Aurelia actually happens.

Size
410 sq ft
Beds
One queen
View
Cypress courtyard
Sleeps
2

The Garden Rooms are the smallest and the quietest, tucked behind the windbreak the original owners planted in the seventies. They open onto the courtyard where breakfast is served, the sauna sits, and the evening fire is lit at dusk.

  • Courtyard
  • Window seat
  • Rain shower
  • Sauna access
  • Quiet wing
